# Paper Plaine

> arXiv research papers explained in plain English, updated twice daily.

Paper Plaine summarizes recent academic research from Cornell's arXiv database. Each paper receives a plain-English summary and a "why it matters" explanation. The site updates automatically at 7 AM and 7 PM UTC with new papers across 9 subject areas.

## Categories

- [AI](https://paperplaine.com/ai): Recent ai papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.
- [Computer Science](https://paperplaine.com/comp-sci): Recent computer science papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.
- [Physics](https://paperplaine.com/physics): Recent physics papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.
- [Mathematics](https://paperplaine.com/math): Recent mathematics papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.
- [Biology](https://paperplaine.com/biology): Recent biology papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.
- [Finance](https://paperplaine.com/finance): Recent finance papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.
- [Statistics](https://paperplaine.com/statistics): Recent statistics papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.
- [Engineering](https://paperplaine.com/engineering): Recent engineering papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.
- [Economics](https://paperplaine.com/economics): Recent economics papers from arXiv, explained in plain English.

## Archive

The full archive of all papers is paginated at 12 per page, starting at https://paperplaine.com.

- Source data: arXiv.org (Cornell University)
- Summaries generated by: Claude AI (Anthropic)
- Update frequency: Twice daily
